summary: All four printed pages closely match the official 2018 ENCS PDF; needs form-local tweaks for Page 1 Items 19-20 checkbox geometry and Page 3 Schedule 6.A.1 Row 8 microscopic font size, plus shared print fixes for comb ticks and schedule amount alignment.

defects.where: Page 1 Item 9 Registered Address, Page 2 Part IV Item 5 Spouse's Name, Page 3 Schedule 5 Descriptions
defects.what: Long text overflows comb boxes and collides directly with comb tick marks.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 19 and 20 (Income EXEMPT / SPECIAL-PREFERENTIAL RATE checkboxes) and Page 2 Items 10-11
defects.what: Yes/No checkbox X marks touched the top and bottom borders of the 8.6pt boxes; centered and sized to 6.2pt in print-overrides/1701-2018.css.
Large or negative computed amounts exceeding 9 comb slots print completely blank.
NOLCO schedule amounts print left-aligned without thousand separators right against the left cell borders.

defects.where: Page 3, Schedule 6.A.1 Row 8 (Total NOLCO - Taxpayer/Filer, column D)
defects.what: Total amount rendered at 4.5px due to a bogus shrink-to-fit override on #p3c186-i in print-overrides/1701-2018.css; removed the bad rule so it renders at normal table size.

defects.where: Page 4, bottom reference tables (Table 1 and Table 2 Tax Rates)
defects.what: Reference tax rate tables are moved out of the filed sheet into guide.html per provenance.json.

defects.where: Screen 02, Part I Item 7 (Alphanumeric Tax Code)
defects.what: Earlier captures displayed 'Item 7 ATC is not available for the Item 6 taxpayer type' beside saved ATC II013. Root cause: validation in crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1701_official.rs:1095-1116 is correct — II013 (Mixed Income - Graduated) requires Item 6 Compensation Earner (frm1701:rdoPg1I6TaxpayerTypeC) to be ticked alongside Single Proprietor (frm1701:rdoPg1I6TaxpayerTypeS). Fixed form-review/scripts/payloads/payload-1701.json (two passes so Single Proprietor is set before Compensation Earner) and retook both BEFORE and AFTER; Screen 02 and Screen 05 now show both boxes ticked with no contradictory ATC warning.

test_data: Scripted via form-review/scripts/seed_and_capture.py on try/forms-neon-1 rebased onto origin/try/forms-shared-print (058a0e9b): seeds the demo taxpayer via profile.save (TIN 00012345300000, name 'SANTOS, JUANA MARIA DELA CRUZ-VILLANUEVA', RDO 008, long two-line Makati address, ZIP 1003, email juana.santos@example.com, phone 09171234567, birth_date 1988-01-15) and replays payload-1701.json via form.fill (pass 1: 165/165 fields including rdoPg1I6TaxpayerTypeS and rdoPg2I3SpouseTypeS; pass 2: 2/2 fields ticking rdoPg1I6TaxpayerTypeC and rdoPg2I3SpouseTypeC; verified 0 text cell diffs between before and after sheet.html, exact 1372x871 screen and 1400x1982 print dimensions).
shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print (owned by neon-4 on try/forms-shared-print): mask comb ticks under overflowing long text, right-align/pad schedule amounts in Schedule 6.A.1/6.A.2, and handle >9-digit/negative comb overflow in Schedule 3.A.
tests_run: Live app capture via just nsh-run-agent linux on fresh scratch DB (1701 screen + print preview with exact BEFORE profile and payload)
open_questions: Print preview window opens natively on Linux via WebKitGTK; full unclipped 1400px-wide print-p*.png pages were rendered from the running app's generated sheet.html via headless Chrome --print-to-pdf + pypdfium2.
